record.title: Evaluate logical archive composition and select the next bounded offline improvement
record.intent: Preserve useful migration evidence without growing a universal acquisition controller.
requirements: Independently review parser bounds and delta semantics; verify full quality packaging and remote CI; commit and push conclusions.
Recheck the authorized deadline and choose only evidence-supported offline successors or a clean final checkpoint.
acceptance: The archive profile and its reuse limits are explicit and supported by controls.
